raw_segments.text: And, as in a body which is diseased, the addition of a touch from without may bring on illness,
and sometimes even when there is no external provocation a commotion may arise within.
In the same way, wherever there is weakness in the state, there is also likely to be illness,
of which the occasion may be very slight, the one party introducing from without their
oligarchical, the other their democratic allies, and then the state falls sick, and is at war
And may be at times distracted, even when there is no external cause.
